prompts.title: 电影式解体肖像提示
prompts.description: 一个详细的提示，用于创建一张超现实、电影级的 8K 图像，描绘一个男人正在分解成烟雾和发光粒子，强调高对比度的戏剧性光线，传达悲伤的特定姿势，以及作为背光的巨大发光新月形能量光环。需要提供面部参考。
prompts.content: Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic 8K image with high-contrast dramatic lighting and a photo-real digital painting aesthetic-use face reference exactly. The man is shown in a full-body side profile facing right, his face and hairstyle copied perfectly with no alterations He wears modern casual streetwear; a light grey crewneck t-shirt, light neutral cargo pants, light-colored high-top boots, and a watch on his left wrist. His posture is slightly slumped, head bowed, eyes looking downward, hands relaxed at his sides, conveying deep introspection and sorrow. Nearly half of his body is dissolving into extremely thick, cloud-like grey smoke filled with glowing yellow dust particles. His left arm, shoulder, torso, legs, and part of his hair become transparent as they break into luminous particles, suggesting active disintegration Behind and partially surrounding him is a massive glowing crescent (C-shaped) energy aura, emitting fiery golden-white plasma light. This aura acts as a powerful rim and backlight, highlighting the smoke, dust, and silhouette. The setting is minimal and stark: a concrete or desolate paved surface meeting a heavily overcast sky. The color palette is nearly monochrome greys and whites, contrasted by intense amber-gold glow, Shallow depth of field, glow/bloom lighting, particle dispersion, cinematic composition, emotional and dramatic atmosphere.

prompts.content:
STRICTLY preserve the appearance of the woman from the photo 1:1 — do not change facial features, proportions, age, skin texture, or individual characteristics. Do not stylize the face.
Create a spring greeting card.
A woman with thick, shiny hair falling freely over her shoulders. Her face is in a slight three-quarter profile, gaze directed upwards and to the right, with a warm, sincere smile.
She is wearing light yellow clothing and an airy yellow scarf that softly frames her face and neck, creating a sense of movement in the wind. In her hands is a bouquet of crocuses and hyacinths.
Background: a clear blue sky and slightly blurred stalks of tall grass, capturing the atmosphere of a fresh spring morning in nature.
Lighting is soft, natural, without harsh shadows.
Style — realistic watercolor greeting card: soft brushstrokes, rich but delicate colors, light paper texture. Neat natural makeup, pink lips, expressive eyebrows.
The composition is designed as a greeting card. Photorealism, high detail, warm spring mood.
prompts.translatedContent:
严格保留照片中女性 1:1 的外貌——不要改变面部特征、比例、年龄、皮肤纹理或个人特点。不要对脸部进行风格化处理。
制作一张春季贺卡。
一位女性，浓密而富有光泽的头发自由地披散在肩上。她的脸部略呈四分之三侧面，目光向上并向右看，带着温暖而真诚的微笑。
她穿着浅黄色衣服，戴着一条轻盈的黄色围巾，围巾柔和地环绕着她的脸庞和颈部，营造出随风飘动的动感。她手中捧着一束番红花和风信子。
